title: Entropy-Bounded Empiricism: Regime-Dependent Validity in Galaxy Rotation Curves
abstract: Complete documentation of the Entropy-Bounded Empiricism (EBE) framework applied to the SPARC175 galaxy rotation curves. The paper reports regime-dependent model validity with 100% EFC success in the FLOW regime (62/62) and strong nonparametric evidence (Mann-Whitney p < 0.0001, Cliff's δ = 0.371), while a CMB null test (p = 0.251) shows no regime structure, supporting the framework's specificity to non-equilibrium systems.
